name: Celebrity Hunted
description: Twelve famous faces go fugitive in this real-life thriller in aid of Stand Up To Cancer. Can they survive 14 days on the run from an elite team of hunters?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The hunters track Jamie Laing and Spencer Matthews' helicopter to the Isle of Wight; can a speedboat-racing friend save them? Steph and Dom Parker try to lie low but can't resist having a good time.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Can Steph pack her bras in time when she and Dom think the hunters are closing in? Anneka makes her first mistake. Spencer walks into a trap. The hunters launch a social media campaign.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jamie begins to crack under the pressure of life on the run. Anneka embarks on a bold mission to record her radio show in London. Jay and Siva try to disguise their boy band looks.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Can any of the remaining celebrity fugitives make it to the extraction point? Or will an ill-timed sunbed be Jamie and Spencer's downfall? Meanwhile, a selfie betrays Jay and Siva's position.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Eight famous faces go on the run and try to avoid capture, for Stand Up To Cancer. A thrilling cat and mouse game ensues as Johnny Mercer MP tries to avoid the hunters and get to Westminster for a crucial Brexit vote.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The hunters surround Kay Burley's hideout. Meanwhile, Chris and Kem from love Island cannot seem to avoid being spotted by the public and Vicky Pattison risks contacting her family.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The hunters turn up the heat on the famous fugitives as AJ and Louis consider splitting up. Later, Chris and Kem decide to flee to a luxury spa but end up in the wrong type of hot water.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The hunters are closing the net on the remaining fugitives and Olympic gymnast Louis Smith finds himself surrounded in a hit tub showroom in a game of hide and seek. Also, tension brews when Johnny's gung-ho attitude rubs Kay up the wrong way.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In the final race to the finish line, the remaining celebrity fugitives attempt to make it to the extraction point. Johnny Mercer MP takes a final gamble, while Chris and Kem call in help from celebrity friends.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Eight famous faces turn fugitive and attempt to evade capture for 14 days. Stanley Johnson and Georgia Toffolo are cornered by the Hunters in Birmingham New Street station.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Chefs Jean-Christophe Novelli and Aldo Zilli go rural to lie low. The Only Way Is Essex stars Lucy Mecklenburgh and Lydia Bright live it up on a yacht - even taking selfies.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: All eight fugitives remain at large. Stanley Johnson decides he's too recognisable in Devon and dyes his hair red, and the hunters rile Martin Offiah by targeting his statue.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Jean-Christophe Novelli and Aldo Zilli have an audacious plan to visit Jean-Christophe's three-year old son in hospital, as he is in remission from cancer. Martin Offiah and Gavin Henson are trapped in a Manchester apartment as the Hunters close in.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The four remaining celebrity fugitives are desperate to outwit the Hunters. But can any of them make it to the helicopter that is waiting to extract them from UK territory?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Four teams of famous faces turn fugitive and attempt to evade capture from an elite team of 30 hunters, in a special event for for Stand Up To Cancer. Taking part are Olympic silver medallist Iwan Thomas with two-time Paralympic gold medallist Richard Whitehead; Made in Chelsea stars Ollie and Gareth Locke-Locke; actor Chizzy Akudolu with queen of UK garage Lisa Maffia; and Drag Race UK winner The Vivienne with international reality TV star Chloe Veitch

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Chloe and The Vivienne come out of hiding for a risky drop-in at Kerry Katona's house. Made in Chelsea's Ollie and Gareth troll the hunters, and Chizzy and Lisa stay under the radar.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The hunters close in on The Vivienne and Chloe. Lisa Maffia breaks cover at a festival in Bristol. Missing home and family could be Iwan Thomas and Richard Whitehead's downfall.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Iwan Thomas and Paralympian Richard Whitehead set a trap for the hunters. Chloe and The Vivienne pine after creature comforts. And the hunters hack Lisa and Chizzy's secret weapon.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Iwan and Richard are chased cross country and one of them might be a sitting duck. The hunters go low in a bid to snare The Vivienne and Chloe - and someone gets hurt.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The clock's counting down. With the last of the fugitives so close to victory, there's one final dramatic chase, with safety the prize.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Nine celebrities break out of Shrewsbury prison. Hotly pursued by an elite team of hunters, it's soon 10 fugitives as one celeb's boyfriend joins the pack.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Two of the fugitives plot a daring return to London and an appearance on live TV. And, could hiding out in a fellow fugitive's home be a really smart move, or pretty stupid?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The hunters track a pair of fugitives to the house of a celebrity pal. Two of the celebs mark their time on the run with a tattoo as they plot a daring stunt.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Two of the celebrity fugitives play a dangerous game calling hunter HQ. Another pair raise the stakes as they take on the hunters for a heart-stopping encounter on the streets of central London.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Two celebrity fugitives keep riding their luck as another pair desperate to make it all the way decide to bare all. And a popular ex-politician makes a guest appearance.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: It's just 48 hours until extraction. With heart-stopping close calls, motorway chases and desperate foot races, 2023's Celebrity Hunted ends on an adrenaline-fuelled high.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The pursuit begins as the celebs make a daring escape from a train in rural Norfolk.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The celebs are roaming free with Hunter HQ under pressure to make some captures ASAP.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A celeb sighting sends the hunters scrambling as another celeb tries to set a world record.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As the hunters up the pace, two celebs get their bikinis out and hit the beach.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A couple of bagless celebs are going stir crazy. Can a psychic help a fugitive stay free?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: One of the celebs goes shopping while another can be found live on TV.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: In a house in south London a celeb is alone and surrounded by hunters. Is this the end?

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: It's extraction time. Hunter HQ is going full on. Will any celebs make it?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Twelve famous faces go on the run in aid of Stand Up To Cancer. Can the likes of Father and daughter performers Brian and Lucy Conley; Strictly pros Amy Dowden and Carlos Gu; presenters JJ Chalmers and Sophie Morgan; comedians Jen Brister and Laura Smyth; reality stars and content creators Chris Taylor and Toby Aromolaran; and presenters Scarlette and Stuart Douglas are the fugitives, evade the brawny brainy army of Hunters?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Two of the competitors drop in on a celebrity colleague to wish them a happy birthday - only to land themselves in potential trouble as they organise their escape. Another pair make a bold move by going on TV to promote their new show. Are they at risk of being nabbed live on air? In Brighton, two of the famous fugitives are cracking jokes but it seems the hunters have rumbled them and are determined to have the last laugh.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A daring escape plot is hatched in Brighton. Two of the celebs tap into a military network for intel and support. But the Hunters have picked up their signal and are closing in. A couple of content creators reckon they know how to outsmart their pursuers.
